## Avenue Shabu Client Project

::::: {.columns .project-section}
::: {.column width="40%"}
![](images/digital-marketing/avenue-shabu.png){.project-image fig-alt="Avenue Shabu client project"}
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
### Promotion and Marketing Performance

As part of my Culminating Experience Project, I am working with Avenue Shabu to evaluate its marketing activities and identify opportunities to improve sales and profitability.

My assigned area compares promotional and non-promotional periods using sales, marketing expenses, food costs, labor costs, and campaign information. The planned analysis includes promotional lift, contribution margin, and return on marketing investment.

**Skills:** Client consulting, promotion analysis, KPI development, ROMI, and marketing performance measurement.
:::
:::::
